description:
Land the final spike: Frame, value_count from the Lowerer, enter_entry, retain_continuation_captures, Lanes, test frames sized from TEST_VALUE_COUNT. The env type is shared by backend.rs, dispatch_exec.rs and continuations, so this is one commit.

Tests: keep the 5 fixed tests; add one that a parked frame holds only the target entry's captures (the 00911 pin covers it end to end).

Docs: the interpreter frame model in .agent/docs, present tense.

Removed: the HashMap environment, delivered_env's map rebuild.

Acceptance: full gate green; no GC pin rises; same-binary A/B on the issue's program shows 3.4 to 3.7 us/element release and 36 to 40 debug.
title: A frame is a table indexed by value id
